title: Shared vocabulary for every documentation entity
description: Definitions referenced by every other schema. Nothing here is an entity in its own right. The three models that matter are CONFIDENCE (how much a claim is trusted), EVIDENCE (why it is trusted) and GIT STATE (whether the evidence is committed truth or an uncommitted working-tree observation). No entity may assert a fact without carrying all three.

confidence.description: How this claim was arrived at. CONFIRMED means directly verified against a file, symbol, command output or git object that exists. INFERRED means reasoned from evidence that does not state it outright. PREDICTED means a forward-looking judgement that has not happened and may never. NEEDS_REVIEW means a human has to decide. A prediction must never be recorded as CONFIRMED, and an absence of evidence is never CONFIRMED.

entityStatus.description: The lifecycle of the documentation entity itself, not of the thing it documents.

dataClassification.description: Whether this entity is safe to publish. The repository is public, so PUBLIC_SAFE is the only classification that may be committed here; anything else must reference a value without copying it (see redact.mjs).

gitState.description: Whether the evidence behind this entity is committed history or an uncommitted working-tree observation. UNCOMMITTED and MODIFIED findings are PROVISIONAL: they describe a tree that only exists on one machine, and must never be presented as branch truth.

evidenceKind.description: What sort of artefact backs a claim. Each kind implies how it can be re-verified.

evidenceItem.description: One re-verifiable reason for a claim. `ref` must be enough to find the evidence again without guessing: a repo-relative path, a path#symbol, a commit sha, or a command.

provenance.description: Who produced this entity and on what basis. `generator` is the script and version for machine-produced entities, or `human` when authored by hand. An entity claiming CONFIRMED with an empty evidence array is invalid by construction.

moduleId.description: The business module an entity belongs to. Closed set, derived from Shared/Authorization/Permissions.cs Modules plus the layers that carry no permission of their own. PLATFORM is cross-cutting infrastructure; WEB is the frontend shell; TOOLING is build/dev-time code that is not the product.

entityEnvelope.description: Fields every persisted entity carries. Included by reference rather than repeated, so a change to the envelope cannot be applied to six schemas and forgotten in the seventh.
